title: Holistic lifecycle policy engine with automated decision playbooks
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: teams need a single, auditable policy layer that encodes rollout decision logic (canary, A/B, shadow validation) and automated rollback playbooks tied to multi-dimensional metrics. This PR introduces a lifecycle policy engine plus a library of decision playbooks so operators can declare "safe" rollouts without custom orchestration code. Key components: 1) policy DSL (YAML) for staged canaries, cohort-based A/B, and shadow-validation flows; 2) a compact evaluation runtime that runs inside the orchestration controller and produces deterministic decisions (promote/halt/quarantine/rollback); 3) a pluggable rollback oracle that synthesizes model-level signals (latency, token error rate, distribution drift) and business KPIs (conversion, retention) into a single safety score; 4) integration with the rollout simulator and the Console UI to preview and rehearse playbooks. This description includes implementation notes, tests, and operational guidance. All sections are in one continuous string as required.

release_notes: Introduces a policy-driven lifecycle engine and decision playbooks for canaries, A/B tests, and shadow validation. Adds an automated rollback oracle and Console preview. Backward compatible: existing rollout CRDs work unchanged. Admins can opt-in to new policies via feature flag 'policy_engine_v1'.

operational_playbook: 1) Opt-in: enable feature flag policy_engine_v1 for a small team; 2) Author: use staged_canary_with_shadow template and set 'business_kpi' anchors; 3) Simulate: run rollout-simulator with recorded traffic and review dry-run; 4) Canary: launch at 1% with shadow validation for 1 hour; 5) Promote: automated promote if safety_score >= 0.9 across windows; 6) Auto-rollback: if safety_score < 0.7 for 3 consecutive windows, the rollback oracle triggers 'immediate-rollback' and notifies on #incidents; 7) Postmortem: inspect playbook-preview logs and decision traces.
migration_steps: 1) Add policy-configmap via helm upgrade (template included). 2) Enable feature flag in Console -> Feature flags. 3) Run 'tools/rollout-simulator --playbook examples/staged_canary_with_shadow.yaml' to validate. 4) Update runbooks to point to new 'decision_trace' logs under /observability/rollouts. 5) For Dedicated customers, include policy schema v1 in on-prem installer bundle.
qa_notes: Unit tests cover parser and evaluator boundary cases. Integration test replays a 24-hour traffic slice and validates that the simulator's predicted decisions match controller decisions within 0.5%. Added a fuzz test for malformed playbooks. Manual test: used Console preview to author a playbook and executed a dry-run; validated decision trace consistency.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: a mis-specified playbook could cause unnecessary rollbacks. Mitigation: dry-run simulator, conservative default weighting, and opt-in feature flag. Risk: evaluator perf could add latency; mitigation: fast-paths, batching, and benchmark thresholds enforced in CI. Risk: business KPI ingestion delay; mitigation: policy supports soft gates (defer decisions until required KPI windows are available).
notes_for_oncall: If automated rollback triggers unexpectedly, check /var/log/redwood/policy_engine/decision-trace.log and the rollout-simulator replay for the same time window. Use CLI 'redwoodctl playbook preview --trace <id>' to retrieve decision inputs. Contact Asha Menon or Lina Park for escalation.
